thesis: Assets whose bounded cross-sectional rank of positive price displacement improves relative to the rank of activity required to produce that displacement are repricing more efficiently; upward migration in this self-asset elasticity rank should continue when residual trend is positive.
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
signal_contract: Compute positive close-to-open displacement normalized by same-day range and cross-sectional percentile-rank it among eligible names. Compute positive log dollar-volume-share surprise versus each asset's 21-day median and cross-sectional percentile-rank it. Daily bounded efficiency is displacement-rank minus activity-rank. Rolling efficiency level over window is compared with its 21-day lag; base node is positive upward migration gated by positive 21-day residual trend.
ablation: use current positive bounded efficiency level instead of its 21-day migration, under the same residual-trend gate
falsifier: deterministically rotate the efficiency-migration values across currently eligible identities before applying the same residual-trend gate
selection: positive scores, top five, deterministic label tie breaks
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cost_hypothesis: Rank-bounded weekly signal avoids unstable raw impact ratios and should be sparse enough for the fixed ATR cost ladder.
failure_mode: rank migration duplicates generic momentum/activity leadership or has no identity-specific content
stop_rule: freeze if matched ablation or destructive falsifier matches/beats the central parent, or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 development floor; do not invert, retune, or grid-rescue after observing failure
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded; 2025+ diagnostic and live evidence never drive mutation
contamination_notes: A-M volatility evidence is already observed. frontier_20260913m reserve returns were not observed before this preregistration. No Frontier-N returns were observed before freeze.
